nba_sxs.definition: sxs grade(): q_close x odds - 1; q from FanDuel's board at its last observation before tip (no time window); the bet line's two-sided no-vig, else an over-only alt rung de-vigged at the main rung's overround; otherwise missing. DraftKings bets scored on FanDuel's close.

nba_clv.definition: nba_clv.py: beat = the closing main line (best of FanDuel+DraftKings, the two-sided rung whose best over is nearest 1.9091, board at tip from the change log) rose above the flagged line, or stayed and its best over shortened; fd_beat = the same on FanDuel alone, flag time vs tip (amendment 4 primary). Binary; no price value.

bet_ledger.definition: bet_ledger.py: (closing_fair x odds_taken - 1); closing_fair = Pinnacle's de-vigged (Shin) probability of the side at the bet line when the game starts. A different reference book (Pinnacle) from the book bet.

wnba_clv.definition: wnba_clv.py: line points the close moved toward the projection, (close_line - flag_line) x sign(proj - flag_line); FanDuel main line; no price value and no de-vig.

k_live.definition: k_live.py: per book, the last snapshot in a 10:00 to next-day 08:00 window (no first-pitch cap, so it can be an in-game price); main = the two-sided rung whose over is nearest 1.9; the best price across books for the side; clv_dir = line direction; clv_pct = odds / close odds - 1 only when the line is unchanged.
